notes: Names printed without suffix are written with 'Street': HOPPLE, GOURD, GILMORE (NOT OPENED), JULIA ANN. Cormany Av changes direction at Stock Av: north of Stock it runs NNE (to Bates Av and beyond to the sheet top); south of Stock its lines are not drawn until the tannery block (~y 5370-5780), and there it runs due south at x~675-690 to Hopple. Cormany/Stock is taken on the upper (NNE) leg's centreline; the lower leg's alignment extended north would cross Stock ~60 px further west. W. McMicken Av also changes direction at the Dixmyth junction (NNE leg along the canal's east bank to the north, nearly N-S to the south); the bend vertex of the two centrelines (~5277,2725) is within ~65 px of the Dixmyth T. Vermont Av appears to end at Bates Alley (the alley's north line is continuous across it). Bates Alley (10 ft) runs from the top edge to the canal property line at its east end. Unnamed 10 ft alley through block 3 runs from the sheet-287 margin across Cormany Av (crossing at ~1235,1419) to Vermont Av; a second unnamed 10 ft alley runs from it SSW to Stock Av. In block 6 an unnamed alley runs from a dead end at a lot line (20 ft, slanting SSW) to the junction with an unnamed 20 ft alley from Gilmore, then nearly due south (15 ft) to Hopple; it is recorded as two segments. Gourd is a narrow (~30 ft) street between the tannery and the canal's west bank; Gilmore (not opened) lies between the canal's east bank and block 6. Gilmore/Hopple is marked cross because Hopple's south line resumes exactly at Gilmore's east line (x~2760), so Gilmore continues south (sheet 283); Gourd/Hopple is marked T (see its note). Hopple's south line lies at y~7675-7695, just above the paper edge.
